answer: A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as every identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The kernel cap is enforced at intake and harbor reveals the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a sonnet tag. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
